title: TIMOULA LTPF record
description: One version of one car in one price list. A car version appears once per price list it is in, each with its own validity window.

brand.description: Uppercase brand as in the price list (e.g. SUBARU, MERCEDES-BENZ).

model_year_tag.description: Model year printed in the list (MY18, MY26), if any.

version.description: Trim / version name exactly as printed (Latin characters normalised).

displacement_cc.description: Exact cc when the list gives it; used for matching against the registration document.

transmission.description: MT, AT, CVT, DCT ... as printed.

body_type.description: Customs depreciation category: suv_atv, hatchback, sedan, cabrio, coupe_roadster, mpv.

ltpf_eur.description: Retail price before taxes (ΛΤΠΦ) of the base version, in euro.

retail_incl_tax_eur.description: Price after taxes, when the list prints it (sanity check only).

valid_to.description: Last day of validity (day before the next list). null = still current, or unknown when later lists are missing (see notes).

source_type.description: gr_official_pricelist = importer list filed with customs. gr_importer_estimate = importer-published values it marks as estimates. gr_similar_model_estimate = derived from a sister version (customs criteria β/γ). foreign_price_estimate = origin-country price, VAT removed (criterion ε). customs_info_form = value returned by a Φόρμα Πληροφόρησης (art. 7).

protocol_no.description: Customs filing protocol number printed on the list.

list_label.description: Label/year printed on the list page.

source_sha256.description: Hash of the downloaded source file, to detect when a list changes.

verified.description: true only after a human or second independent read confirmed the price.
